notes.title: First public appearance of Wonderfall at gamescom!
notes.content:
Hello curious mind,


An ancient world is awakening… and you’re among the first to hear its echoes.


We’re excited to share that Wonderfall will make its public debut at gamescom 2025!
It’ll be your very first chance to experience the game hands-on, through an exclusive playable version.



But this is just a glimpse.
A more complete demo will be available on Steam this fall, during the Steam Next Fest. 



Add Wonderfall to your wishlist so you don’t miss the moment the gates open.



Léon is waiting...

Stay tuned.

notes.title: Wonderfall - Official Game Trailer
notes.content:
Hello everyone!


We’re thrilled to share the first glimpse of Wonderfall with you. 

Discover a hauntingly beautiful 1920s Paris slowly consumed by Entropy — a mysterious force turning buildings to sand and dust.


[previewyoutube="9jTU4h_BCyA;full"][/previewyoutube]


Step into the shoes of Léon, a young orphan with the unique ability to shape the sand itself. Navigate a crumbling city through puzzles, platforming challenges, and contemplative exploration as you unravel the truth behind the city’s collapse.



Every building holds secrets, and every corner of Paris whispers stories of a world slipping away. 

Will you uncover the mystery before it’s lost forever?



Stay tuned — more adventures await this fall!
